article.story: LITTLE ROCK, Ark. -- — Jalen Lynn scored 15 points as Little Rock beat Lane 88-58 on Friday. Lynn shot 5 of 10 from the field, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 4 from the line for the Trojans (4-4). Tyrese Lacey scored 14 points while shooting 6 for 9, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc, and added seven assists and four steals. Jamai Felt shot 4 of 5 from the field and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 11 points. Xavier Bell led the Dragons with 11 points. Taylor Conner added 10 points for Lane. Randy Emerson finished with eight points. Up next Little Rock visits Jacksonville State in its next matchup on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
